details: CONFIRMED by reading: templates/bin-wt lines 9-12 have no case on the name; lib/relay_setup.py:972-976 copies it to
<project>/bin/wt on first setup. The wt/queue-* readers (tidy, doctor, inert, merge hook, relay queue) run in every project, so
the item's failing case is reachable in each project relay sets up, not only in relay. Same defect as the item, so the same
severity (LOW). Projects already set up keep their old bin/wt (setup writes it only when missing); that part is not fixable
here. Size: 10 agent minutes (3 lines plus one test over the rendered template).
evidence: sed -n 9,12p templates/bin-wt -> new) name="${2:?name}"; base="${3:-{{branch}}}" / mkdir -p "$dir" / git worktree add ... -b "wt/$name"
failing_case: A project set up by relay (bin/wt written from templates/bin-wt). The front, told by guard_main to use bin/wt new <name>, runs
bin/wt new queue-docs main there: it makes .worktrees/queue-docs on wt/queue-docs, which relay doctor lists as a leftover queue
branch and tidy and the merge hook skip as a landing branch. Expected: refused as in relay's own bin/wt.
fix_hint: Copy the same case "$name" in queue-*) ... exit 2 ;; esac block into templates/bin-wt after line 10, and extend
tests/test_bin_wt.py to run it over the rendered template too.
pass_cases: 1. templates/bin-wt rendered (branch=main), run in a temp repo: new queue-docs main -> exit non-zero, stderr names "queue-",
2. Same rendered template: new docs main -> .worktrees/docs on wt/docs, exit 0, prints the path.
3. relay's own bin/wt keeps both behaviours of tests/test_bin_wt.py.
reason: tests/test_bin_wt.py:45 TemplateBinWtNew runs both cases over the rendered template; fails at base, passes now.
findings.summary: the bin/wt template that relay setup writes into every project still makes wt/queue-<x>; only relay's own copy was fixed

details: CONFIRMED by reading the diff. The same rule also says "Anything beyond a thin wrapper is Python", and bin/wt is still a thin
wrapper over git worktree (26 lines), so the breach is small; rated LOW (the rule sets no severity). Moving it to Python would
also mean deciding whether the project template (templates/bin-wt, used by bun/mix projects) moves, which is larger than this
item. Listed so the owner sees it; dropping it is acceptable. Size: 30 agent minutes for relay's own bin/wt.
evidence: git diff master...HEAD -- bin/wt -> +case "$name" in / +queue-*) echo "bin/wt: the name prefix 'queue-' is reserved ..." >&2; exit 2 ;; / +esac
failing_case: Project rule (CLAUDE.local.md, Python): "Bash is on its way out: do not grow a bash script, move it to Python when you next change
it." This change adds 3 lines of bash logic to bin/wt (a name check with its own message and exit code) and keeps it bash.
Expected by the rule: bin/wt moved to Python, or the check left out of bash.
fix_hint: Leave as is (thin wrapper) and drop, or rewrite bin/wt as a Python script with the same contract when bin/wt is next changed.
pass_cases: 1. bin/wt new queue-docs master -> refused as now (tests/test_bin_wt.py test_queue_prefix_refused).
2. bin/wt new docs master -> .worktrees/docs on wt/docs (test_plain_name_unchanged).
3. bin/wt rm docs and bin/wt ls behave as before.
reason: LOW, dropped per the finding (thin wrapper); fixer left it. Not a defect to fix.
findings.summary: Python rule: the fix grows a bash script instead of moving it to Python, as the project rule asks on its next change
